OnlyProduct.description:
The one Product that carries a story or a matrix row: only Foxhound can
be, since Foxhound contains Collie (ADR 0084).

id.description: The row's ID in the matrix, such as `RT-10` or `durability-resume`.

milestone.description: The GitHub milestone of the ticket that finishes it.

product.description:
The one Product that carries it, for a row of Foxhound's alone; both
Products when absent (ADR 0094).

row.description: The rows given a milestone so far.
